tagline: Small-batch coffee, roasted where the lake meets the woods.
summary: Northlight is a neighborhood roaster for people who want great coffee without the ceremony. The brand is warm, plain-spoken and a little outdoorsy.

logos.name: Reversed logo
logos.usage: On the forest green and on dark photography.

logoRules.clearSpace: Keep the height of the mark clear on every side.

colorUsage.bg: Page backgrounds and large calm areas.
colorUsage.primary: Buttons, header bands and key moments.
colorUsage.onPrimary: Text and icons on the forest green.
colorUsage.accent: Highlights and tags. A ground, never text on light backgrounds.

voice.summary: We sound like the friend behind the counter who knows a lot and shows off none of it.

traits.name: Warm
traits.do: Come by early, the first batch is still warm.
traits.dont: Patrons are invited to arrive at opening.

traits.name: Plain-spoken
traits.dont: A multidimensional cup with an effervescent acidity profile.

traits.name: Outdoorsy
traits.description: Borrow from the lake and the woods, lightly.

examples.write: New single origin just hit the shelf. Tastes like a cold morning that warms up fast.
examples.avoid: Introducing our latest premium artisanal offering!!!
We are currently closed. We apologize for any inconvenience.

imagery.summary: Natural light, real hands, real mugs. Morning over midday. Never stock.

do: Use the forest green for one moment per screen.
Pair Fraunces headlines with Inter body text.
dont: Set body text in the accent amber.
Place the primary logo on photography.
